spells.name: Super Scorcher Breath
spells.description: Smolder belches flame, dealing physical damage + magic damage. If the target dies, Smolder refunds Mana, once per cast. Based on stacks of Dragon Practice, this Ability evolves to gain the following effects: Stacks: Damages all enemies surrounding the target. Stacks: Sends explosions beyond the target that deal % of this Ability's damage. Stacks: Burns the target, dealing max Health true damage over seconds. Enemy champions that drop below total health while burning are killed instantly.
spells.coverageNote: The generic direct-damage evaluator preserves the structured formula and complete rank arrays. The full patch description is retained and assigned to the scheduled-damage family, but a complete reviewed binding has not been compiled yet.
